links.outcome: Independent clinician review of ML recommendations against standard guidelines for discrepancies
links.effect: Among 644 clinician-trained reports, no major discrepancies in recommendations, with only 100 showing minor differences.
links.quote: Among 644 clinician-trained reports, there were no major discrepancies in recommendations, with only 100 showing minor differences.

unlisted_practices: Testing whether ML system distinguishes trained from novel data inputs (novelty/out-of-distribution recognition) using BioFire molecular panel inputs

screen.reason: Evaluates a clinical decision support system's internal safety capability to identify novel versus trained data points (out-of-distribution / novel data detection guardrail) alongside clinical recommendation accuracy.
